s1.text:
Round 4 — from your notes:
1. My day's sentence only counts what's on the plan: “A full afternoon. 9½ hours planned, 3½ free — most of it before 2.” No claims about things Navi didn't do.
2. Timeline · Calendar toggle on My day. Calendar opens on Week (Day too); Timeline stays the default.
3. Navi panel states: knows the page you're on, keeps draft and voice when closed, quiet badge, Focus holds non-urgent items.
4. Advanced features hidden until needed: a small search icon (⌘K) in the sidebar. Palette + task “More details” board: not drawn yet.
5. “Where each sentence comes from” board: not drawn yet.
